notes: v029 is underdetermined and resolves to the base; ἀπό is translated at t008.

The determiner the at t004 is placed on the anarthrous ἐπικουρίας rather than on the following article, an article that follows its noun leaving the determiner on the noun and keeping only the relativizer (rule 31); the copula is goes with ἀπό, the modifier having no verb.
τῆς before ἡμέρας is emptied by the demonstrative ταύτης (rule 38), and the first τε of τε … καί is empty with only one conjunction written (rule 70).
